customProperties.description: List of all custom properties defined within the application.

id.description: Unique identifier of the custom property.

name.description: Name of the custom property as it appears in the UI and targeting rules.

type.description: Data type of the custom property. Valid values: Boolean, String, Semver, Number, DateTime.

description.description: Human-readable description of the custom property's purpose.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the application that owns this custom property.

cascUrl.description: URL of the CasC (configuration-as-code) representation of this custom property.
